init.header: claude-master init — values read from this machine (key · value · source)
init.exists: already exists: {path} — rerun with --force to overwrite (the previous one goes to {path}.bak)
init.shim_written: shim installed: {path} (resolves the plugin root at every call)
doctor.no_config: no configuration file at {path}: defaults apply
doctor.backend_none: backend “none”: no window will be opened (headless)
doctor.cb_missing: chrome-bridge CLI not found at {path}: tile/merge/move unavailable
doctor.fix_cb: point tile.chrome_bridge_cli at chrome-bridge's cli.js, or leave it empty to disable
doctor.shim_not_in_path: {dir} is not in PATH: the `claude-master` command is not found by name
doctor.fix_shim_path: add to your .bashrc or .zshrc: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" — then open a new terminal
doctor.cb_unset: tile.chrome_bridge_cli empty: tile/merge/move will report “requires chrome-bridge”
doctor.hook_dup: account “{account}”: local-time hook also in {path} (with the plugin it arrives twice)
doctor.fix_hook_dup: at cut-over remove that hook from settings.json (back it up first)
doctor.legacy: legacy scripts present in {path}: parallel-trial mode
doctor.shim_missing: shim {path} missing: `claude-master` is not on the shell PATH
cli.unported: claude-master {cmd}: not ported yet (phase {phase} of the plan). Today: {legacy}
shim.unresolved: claude-master: plugin root not found. Set CLAUDE_MASTER_ROOT, or plugin_root in the configuration, or install the plugin (claude plugin install claude-master@...)
sessions.abandoned: stuck on a question, nobody watching
sessions.abandoned_hint: {n} stuck on a question with nobody attached: closing it interrupts no work in progress, only work already stopped.
sessions.tmux_dead: WARNING: the tmux server is not responding. The sessions above keep running, but cannot be driven from outside any more (no talk, no restart).
sessions.footer_native: native channel:  SendMessage (or @name in the prompt) — same peer registry; notify_when_idle tells you when that session is done
sessions.footer_talk: talk channel:    claude-master talk <name> "the prompt" — for sessions outside the registry
sessions.columns: PID ACCOUNT NAME STATE FOLDER WINDOW CHANNEL UPTIME VERSION
sessions.outdated: * = older than {version} on disk: a session picks up the new version only when it restarts (claude-master restart arm, from inside)
attach.missing: claude-master attach: no such session: {name}. Running:
terminal.backend_unknown: claude-master: unknown terminal backend “{backend}” (chromeos, gnome, kitty, iterm2, macos-terminal, wt, none)
quota.header: ACCOUNT          5 H    WEEK       WEEKLY RESET      READING
quota.window_expired: WARNING: for “{account}” the week has already reset: the percentage belongs to the closed week and says nothing about the current one. A turn on that account is needed.
quota.old_note: Readings marked (old) date from that account's last session: they refresh only when one runs.
quota.missing_note: An account without data is not an account at zero: no session with the statusline active has run on it yet.
launch.usage: usage: claude-master launch <absolute path> [--create] [--continue|--resume <id>] [--account N] [--no-window] [--bg] [--profile N]
launch.resume_needs_id: claude-master launch: --resume needs the conversation id
launch.continue_xor_resume: claude-master launch: --continue and --resume exclude each other: -c takes the latest conversation, --resume a specific one. Pick one.
launch.not_absolute: claude-master launch: an absolute path is required, got: {path}
launch.legacy_flag: claude-master launch: {flag} is the historical name: it means --{account}
launch.account_mismatch: claude-master launch: warning — the path says “{deduced}”, you asked for “{asked}”. Proceeding as asked.
launch.no_tmux: claude-master launch: tmux is not installed
launch.no_claude: claude-master launch: claude not found — tried: {tried}
launch.agent_off: claude-master launch: --agent {agent} is an experiment, off by default: set experimental.{agent} to true in the configuration to try it
launch.unknown_agent: claude-master launch: unknown agent “{agent}” (claude, or codex when experimental.codex is on)
launch.no_codex: claude-master launch: codex not found — tried: {tried}
launch.agent_no_bg: claude-master launch: --bg works only with Claude Code
launch.missing_dir:
claude-master launch: the directory does not exist: {path}
  pass --create to create it
launch.not_a_dir: claude-master launch: exists but is not a directory: {path}
launch.resume_missing:
claude-master launch: no conversation “{id}” for this directory.
  looked in: {dir}
launch.died:
claude-master launch: session “{name}” died right after starting.
  try by hand: cd {dir} && claude
launch.stuck_dialog:
claude-master launch: session “{name}” is stuck on a dialog (trust/permissions).
  answer by hand: tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.window_attached: window open and attached · tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.window_failed: WINDOW NOT OPENED (two attempts): open it by hand with  tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.window_skipped: no window (backend none or no display) · tmux attach -t ={name}
launch.slow_screen: screen slow to draw and registry not written yet: check it is not stuck on a dialog
launch.no_link: find it by folder in the app's list: the link is not in the registry yet
close.attached:
claude-master close: “{name}” is OPEN — someone is looking at it.
  if it is a forgotten window of yours, rerun with --dry-run to see, or close it from inside with /exit.
close.none_abandoned: no detached session stuck on a question
talk.usage: usage: claude-master talk <name> "prompt" [--wait S] [--quiet S] [--no-wait] [--force] [--via auto|socket|tmux]
talk.missing: claude-master talk: no such session “{name}”. Running:
talk.self: claude-master talk: “{name}” is this very session: a prompt to itself would land mid-turn
talk.native_hint: claude-master talk: “{name}” shares your peer registry: from a Claude session the native channel is better (ListAgents → SendMessage, with notify_when_idle). Proceeding anyway (NATIVO=no to silence this).
talk.no_tmux: claude-master talk: “{name}” is not in tmux and has no socket: it cannot be driven from outside
talk.socket_failed: claude-master talk: delivery to the socket of “{name}” failed: {error}
talk.socket_fallback: claude-master talk: socket of “{name}” unreachable ({error}): falling back to tmux
talk.timeout: ── ({s}s cap reached: the session is still working)
report.no_project: claude-master report: no folder for “{project}”. Similar:
report.not_delivered: session “{name}” absent and --no-launch: the text was not delivered.
report.followup: the session is reading it; for the outcome look at its window, ask “news?” or use `claude-master wait {name}`
doctor.inbound_held: account “{account}”: without `crossSessionInbound: accept` in its settings, `talk` (socket) messages stay HELD pending confirmation
doctor.fix_inbound: add "crossSessionInbound": "accept" to the account's settings.json (applies to sessions started afterwards)
restart.usage: usage: claude-master restart arm [--clean|--switch-account [NAME]] | list | hook | failed | exec <flag>
restart.not_in_tmux: claude-master restart: this session is not running in tmux, no automatic restart
restart.no_tmux_id: claude-master restart: cannot identify the current tmux session
restart.no_session_id: claude-master restart: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID missing, no conversation to resume
restart.which_account: claude-master restart: more than one account possible, name it: --switch-account <name> (known: {known})
restart.armed_switch: ACCOUNT SWITCH: restarts on “{account}” resuming conversation {sid} — from then on the context goes to the API under the other organization
restart.armed_clean: CONTEXT CLEARED: restarts without -c (memory on disk untouched)
restart.armed_when: fires at the end of the turn; outcome and link in {log}
restart.in_progress: restart in progress — the session closes and restarts resuming the conversation; link in {log}
queue.added: queued for “{name}”: {n} pending (delivered at the next finished turn)
shell.account_mismatch: note: you are in a folder of account “{expected}” but opening “{asked}” — the typed command stays sovereign.
shell.restore_prompt: machine just restarted: Claude sessions registered before the reboot.
init.shell_written:
shell file written: {path}
  add to your rc (~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc):  source {path}
next.why_abandoned: stuck on a question, nobody watching
next.why_stalled: busy for {min} min with no change (stalled?)
next.why_recent: finished {min} min ago: outcome to read
next.nothing: no session needs you right now
sessions.stalled: busy for {min} min with no change
sessions.quota_warn: QUOTA: “{account}” has used {pct}% of the week (threshold {threshold}%): consider the other account for new work
park.attached: park: “{name}” is OPEN (someone is watching): not parked
park.busy: park: “{name}” is working: --force to interrupt it
park.no_session_id: park: “{name}” has no conversation id in the registry: it could not be resumed
park.none_idle: no detached session idle for more than {min} min
park.ram_low: free RAM {free} MB < {limit} MB: parking the longest-idle detached session
park.ram_low_nothing: free RAM {free} MB < {limit} MB but no detached idle session to park
cloud.usage: usage: claude-master cloud <dir> "task" [--account N] | follow <id> "message" | desk [start|stop|status] [--no-window]
cloud.in_tmux: still running in “{name}”: attach with  tmux attach -t ={name}  (list: claude agents --json --all)
cloud.tmux_busy: claude-master cloud: tmux session “{name}” already exists (a cloud launch still running?): attach or close it first
desk.disabled: claude-master desk: off by default (desk.enabled = false): the root session is the phone's entry point. Set desk.enabled to true in the config to use it.
desk.died: desk “{name}” died at once: `claude remote-control` does not start (login? plan?)
desk.started: desk “{name}” started in {dir}: from the phone you can open new sessions here without going through the master
restore.as_tabs: tabs in one Terminal window, one at a time — {plan}
restore.no_tty: no terminal to answer here: nothing relaunched. Run  claude-master restore --yes  to relaunch these sessions.
init.tmux_block:
block for {path} (keys from tmux.keybindings; --yes appends it, then `tmux source-file {path}`):
{block}
init.tmux_installed: block appended to {path}: reload with  tmux source-file {path}
tile.needs_bridge: claude-master tile: requires chrome-bridge (tile.chrome_bridge_cli = {path}, not found). Leave empty to disable or point at chrome-bridge's cli.js.
tile.needs_chromeos: claude-master tile: arranging windows requires the ChromeOS Terminal (backend “chromeos”), here the backend is “{backend}”
tile.plan_no_monitor: “{name}” is not among the visible monitors ({known}): it would have to be found by pushing a window against it
tile.move_no_window:
move_tab on {name}: no window id in the reply
{resp}
tile.maximized_detached: {name}: window {state}, reopened in a new window
tile.narrow_stack: stacked column of {px} px, below tile.min_column_px ({min}): the windows on the right are narrow
tile.narrow_grid: {px} px per column is below tile.min_column_px ({min}): grid instead
tile.scattered: sessions scattered over {n} monitors: gathering them on “{where}”
tile.no_monitor_there: no monitor at “{name}”: I did not move. Those I see: {known}. A monitor with no window on it is invisible to Chrome: drag a window there and retry.
tile.stale_monitor:
monitor “{name}” ({w}x{h} at {l},{t}) no longer exists: stale entry removed from the registry.
Retry: the probe will look for it again.
tile.unmeasured: monitor not measurable: tiling within the space already occupied
tile.no_reference:
cannot tell which monitor the windows are on.
Open a browser tab on that screen, or pass --area L,T,W,H
tile.no_home_window: the collecting window did not open on {name}
tile.no_new_tab: window opened but no new tab found
tile.only_home_windows: no window without the start tab: collecting in {win}, which keeps it (the SWA will not close it while other tabs exist). For a clean window drag a session tab out, then run merge again.
tile.tab_window_opened: {name}: no Terminal window with a shell: opened a plain window, the session is its tab (the next ones go there)
tile.tab_plan_new: {name}: no Terminal window: one plain window through garcon, the others as tabs inside
tile.no_source: window {win} has no duplicable tab any more
tile.no_client: {name}: no new tab attached within {s}s — the old ones were NOT closed, the session is safe
tile.no_monitors: no monitor recognized: no maximized window and no browser tab to read it from
tile.where_note: monitors with no window on them do not appear: for those use `claude-master move <place>`, which bumps into them to find them
tile.move_usage: usage: claude-master move <place> [sessions...]   (places: native, left, right, above, below)
tile.layout_missing: warning: sessions present at save time are missing now: {names} — restore repositions only the windows it recognizes
relay.usage: usage: claude-master relay push [--dry-run|--async] | pair [--timeout S] | serve | ensure | status | install | uninstall | off
relay.disabled: claude-master relay: off (relay.enabled = false). Set it to true in the config with relay.firebase_url and the service account.
relay.no_sa: relay: no Firebase service account in {path} (0600, never in the repo)
relay.no_key: relay: no key in relay.dir — run `claude-master relay pair` first
relay.no_url: relay: relay.firebase_url is empty in the config
relay.pair_code: Pairing code (5 minutes): {code}   — type it on the watch
relay.pair_failed: pairing FAILED: {n} attempts with a wrong code
relay.pair_timeout: pairing timed out: no watch in {s} s
relay.serve_locked: another `relay serve` holds the lock: never two listeners
relay.cron_installed: lines installed in the crontab (ensure + heartbeat every {s} s)
relay.cron_removed: relay lines removed from the crontab
relay.cmd_reopen_done_last: reopened {name} ({account}): last conversation in the folder
relay.cmd_reopen_ambiguous: {name}: conversation unknown and {n} live session(s) in its folder: use launch
relay.cmd_no_allow_all: no «don't ask again» option on this question
relay.cmd_high: allow_all is not allowed on a high-tier question
relay.cmd_bad_answer: answer {arg}: expected a number, text:<text> or chat
relay.prompt_prefix: From the user via the watch. Answer in your own window as to a user message: do NOT SendMessage claude-master or the master. End your answer with one line «Watch: <the bare outcome, 60 characters at most>»: it is the only line the smartwatch shows.
bot.no_token: claude-master bot: no TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in {path} (configure Claude Code's telegram plugin first).
recap.title: Recap {label} — {n} sessions, {turns} turns, {waits} waits
recap.empty: no ledger event in this range
recap.no_chats: claude-master recap: no chat in allowFrom (the telegram plugin's access.json)
recap.cron_absent: no recap line in the crontab
recap.cron_removed: recap line removed from the crontab
night.usage: usage: claude-master night add <dir> "prompt" [--account N] [--model M] [--effort E] [--max-turns N] | list | remove <id> | clear | run [--dry-run] [--one] [--send] | install | uninstall | status
night.add_usage: usage: claude-master night add <dir> "prompt" [--account N] [--model M] [--effort E] [--max-turns N]
night.quota_high: five-hour quota of “{account}” at {pct}%, above night.max_quota_pct ({max})
night.summary_title: Night shift: {n} jobs run, {left} still queued
night.cron_absent: no night-shift line in the crontab
night.cron_removed: night-shift line removed from the crontab
night.status_guards: guards: free RAM {mb} MB (min {min}), five-hour quota max {max}%
tile.layout_restored: layout “{name}”: {n} windows repositioned, {missing} saved ones not found, {extra} present but not in the layout
recap.title_short: Recap {label} · {n} projects · {waits} waiting on a question
recap.usage: usage: claude-master recap [--date D|--since HOURS] [--send] [--full] [--json] | install | uninstall | status
recap.log_written: line of the day written in {n} projects ({file})
guard.usage: usage: claude-master guard run | install | uninstall | status
guard.warn: ⚠️ quota “{account}” at {pct}% ({window}): resets at {t}. Sessions that hit the wall resume on their own at the reset.
guard.resumed: ✅ quota “{account}” back: {n} sessions resumed ({names}); night queue: {night}
guard.cron_absent: no guard line in the crontab
guard.cron_removed: guard line removed from the crontab
answer.no_question: “{name}”: no open question on screen (no “Enter to select”)
answer.question: “{name}” asks — {header}: {question}
answer.no_option: option {n} does not exist: there are {options}
answer.cursor_lost: the cursor did not reach option {n}: nothing confirmed
answer.synth_prompt: Rewrite this question as ONE complete, self-contained interrogative sentence of at most {n} characters, keeping what it is about; answer with the sentence only: {question}
answer.notify_hint: reply “{n} to {name}” to the master  ·  claude-master answer {name} N
doctor.plugin_ok: account “{account}”: plugin claude-master {version} in the cache{note}
doctor.plugin_stale: account “{account}”: cache at {cache}, checkout at {checkout} — hooks run from the cache
doctor.fix_plugin_stale: claude plugin update claude-master (with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for the other account), then restart the sessions
doctor.plugin_error: account “{account}”: the plugin reports an error: {error}
doctor.plugin_unknown: account “{account}”: `claude plugin list --json` unavailable (Claude Code < 2.1.268?): cache version not checked
relay.fallback_notice: The watch has not been receiving for {min} minutes, so the notice comes through here:
tune.not_ready_busy: {name} is working: try again when it is idle
tune.not_ready_typed: {name} has text typed in its prompt
relay.cmd_launch_no_prompt: launched {name} ({account}), but the first message was not delivered: {line}
